# Example of input validation and sanitization in Rails
class Recipe < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :comments, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :ratings, dependent: :destroy

  validates :title, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :ingredients, presence: true
  validates :instructions, presence: true

  before_save :sanitize_inputs

  private

  def sanitize_inputs
    self.title = ActionController::Base.helpers.sanitize(self.title)
    self.instructions = ActionController::Base.helpers.sanitize(self.instructions)
  end
end
